job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
ABOUT US

AssetPlus is redefining wealth management in India. We build a high-performance SaaS fintech platform that empowers mutual fund distributors (MFDs) and financial advisors with modern tools to streamline investment management. Our mission is to construct India’s premier assisted wealth management platform, helping millions of households achieve their long-term financial goals.




ENGINEERING @ ASSETPLUS

Our engineering team is a high-velocity, growth-focused group of ~18 engineers structured across three core product pods in Chennai. We operate on a modern, AI-enabled Node.js + TypeScript + MongoDB stack, end-to-end owning our services in production with high autonomy while maintaining rigorous technical and cultural standards. If you thrive on solving complex, impactful problems with full ownership, AssetPlus is the place for you.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Software Engineer (SDE-3) to own features end-to-end, exercise high autonomy, and elevate technical excellence across the team. You bring strong technical judgment, speed, clarity, and architectural simplicity to your work. As a core builder reporting to a Staff Engineer in a product pod, you will design services, write production-grade Node.js + TypeScript code, architect MongoDB schemas, debug across backend, React, and Flutter apps, and ensure high system reliability. You will also leverage AI-driven development as a core cognitive partner to accelerate delivery while upholding exceptional quality.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architecture & Systems

Design and build scalable, resilient microservices and features with high autonomy within your pod's domain.
Lead system design reviews, articulating technical trade-offs with first-principles reasoning.
Evaluate and decide whether to build, reuse, or integrate open-source solutions, justifying architecture choices.
Establish, follow, and strengthen team-wide modern architectural patterns and best practices.

Hands-On Engineering

Write clean, highly maintainable, and testable Node.js + TypeScript code for production systems.
Architect efficient MongoDB schemas and build optimized aggregations for high-throughput queries.
Debug full-stack issues across React, Flutter, and backend services down to database and infrastructure layers.
Utilize modern AI developer tools to ship features rapidly with end-to-end ownership without compromising code quality.

AI-Driven Engineering

Leverage AI tools as a cognitive partner to accelerate code generation, debugging, system design, and execution.
Integrate AI models, context, and workflows into daily development loops for maximum efficiency.
Continuously explore and adopt emerging AI capabilities to improve engineering output and code reliability.
Promote AI-native engineering practices and workflows across your product pod.

Reliability & Support

Monitor system health proactively and identify potential issues before impact.
Respond swiftly to critical incidents, ensuring minimal downtime and high uptime.
Lead root-cause analyses (RCAs), optimize system performance, and enhance observability.

Developer Experience & Quality

Enhance internal developer tooling, automation, and CI/CD workflows.
Uphold rigorous engineering standards around code clarity, testing, security, and simplicity.
Champion lightweight, modular, and maintainable engineering design principles.

Leadership & Collaboration

Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, providing constructive code reviews and technical guidance.
Communicate technical architecture and product decisions clearly across stakeholders.
Foster an open, collaborative, and fast-paced engineering culture.




WHAT WE LOOK FOR

Requirements:

6–8 years of full-stack engineering experience with a strong backend focus (tenure is indicative; we value ownership and capability).
Proven track record with Node.js and TypeScript in production, having owned services end-to-end.
Deep expertise in MongoDB schema design, indexing, and complex aggregations.
Experience operating high-load production systems with full accountability for uptime and performance.
Strong full-stack debugging skills spanning backend services, frontends, and database layers.
Pragmatic technical judgment with a bias for simple, maintainable solutions over complex ones.
Excellent communication skills to articulate technical ideas and system decisions clearly.

Preferred Qualifications:

Hands-on AWS experience (e.g., CloudWatch, ECS, Amplify, Lambda, SQS, SES).
Working knowledge of React and/or Flutter for cross-stack debugging.
Prior experience in Fintech, Wealth-tech, or SEBI-regulated environments.
Active use of AI tools to significantly boost engineering velocity.
Experience mentoring junior engineers and conducting high-quality code reviews.
Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and GitHub-based development workflows.

job.title: Senior Full-stack Engineer - (Cloud, AI)
job.description:
TechGrove is the Centre of Excellence for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

 

Senior Full-stack Engineer - (AI, Cloud)

TechGrove AI Engineering Pod

You are a versatile, senior full-stack engineer who likes to own a feature from the database all the way to the pixel, and you ship. You are fluent across the stack, comfortable in the cloud, and you have leaned into AI-native development as a way to move faster without cutting corners. You take pride in clean, well-tested, production-quality code.

As a Senior Full-stack Engineer (Cloud), you are the delivery muscle of the pod. You build modernized, cloud-native applications end to end: cloud services and data, robust APIs, and modern, responsive user interfaces aligned to the OpCo’s design system. You develop natively with agentic tooling such as Claude Code, and you help set the standard for how the pod uses it.

If you want to build real products with senior peers, with AI woven through your daily workflow, this is the team.

About the Pod

A TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self-contained, AI-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan’s AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match.

A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan’s India-based TechGrove.

What You Will Do
Deliver full-stack features: Own complex features end to end: backend services, APIs, data, and UI, writing clean, well-tested, production-quality code.
Build great frontends: Build responsive, accessible interfaces in React.js and Next.js, implementing against the OpCo’s design system and shared component library for visual and behavioral consistency.
Engineer for the cloud: Design and build scalable, secure, resilient applications on cloud-native infrastructure.
Design APIs and data: Build robust APIs (REST and GraphQL) and well-designed SQL/No-SQL data models supporting microservices and cloud-native patterns.
Develop AI-natively: Use and champion AI-assisted development tooling (Claude Code and similar) to maximize velocity and code quality across the SDLC.
Own delivery and DevSecOps: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) for rapid, reliable, secure deployments.
Raise quality through reviews: Participate in and lead code reviews, including of AI-generated code, upholding design patterns (DDD), testing, and application-security standards.
Integrate and modernize: Implement integration patterns connecting new services with the OpCo’s existing systems as part of modernization and re-platforming.
Own it in production: Take ownership through deployment and operation, contributing to observability, performance, and reliability.
What You Bring
Experience: Strong software engineering experience building production applications.
Production experience on AWS or Azure (required): You have built and run production applications on AWS or Azure. Experience limited to GCP alone does not meet this requirement, although GCP in addition to AWS or Azure is a plus.
Full-stack ability: Strong proficiency across the stack: modern backend languages and modern UI frameworks (React.js, Next.js, Vite).
Modern tech stack: Strong, hands-on experience with at least one of: .NET Core, Python, TypeScript, or Java.
Frontend and design systems: Solid hands-on React.js experience: building responsive, accessible UIs from reusable components, managing client-side state, and working within an established design system and component library.
APIs and data: Hands-on experience designing APIs (REST and/or GraphQL) and working with SQL and No-SQL databases.
IaC and DevSecOps: Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) and building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
AI-native tooling: Fluency with AI-assisted development tooling (Claude Code or similar) as a core part of daily work.
Engineering principles: Solid grounding in DDD, clean code, SOLID and DRY, test-driven development, strong typing, and code hygiene.
Problem solving: Structured technical problem-solving (decomposition, hypothesis-driven testing) to debug complex issues in distributed systems.
Agile and ownership: Experience working in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) with a proactive ownership mindset.
Nice to Have
Containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions).
Experience developing GenAI capabilities (LangChain, LlamaIndex) or multi-agent frameworks (crewAI, AutoGen).
Message queuing and streaming technologies (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
Experience with SaaS operating models and observability / APM tooling.
Experience with application modernization or re-platforming.
Working knowledge of GCP, in addition to AWS or Azure.
What Success Looks Like
First 90 days: You are shipping production features independently, your code sets a clean example for the pod, and you are using agentic tooling fluently in your daily workflow.
First 6 months: You are trusted with complex, cross-cutting features, you raise quality through reviews and patterns, and you are a dependable engine of the pod’s delivery.
Why TechGrove, Why Banyan
Permanent home, long-term thinking: Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip.
Real ownership: You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the “what”; the pod owns the “how.”
AI-native by default: You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build.
Variety with stability: Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you.
Growth and excellence: A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time.
Should You Apply?

We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that.

We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes.

 

Beware of Recruitment Scams

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment. 

Protect yourself by following these steps:

Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware.com email address.
Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Full Stack Software Developer based in India.

This role offers the opportunity to build and evolve critical features across a modern SaaS platform serving a global user base. You’ll work across both frontend and backend systems, contributing to scalable, secure, and high-performance applications. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, designers, QA specialists, and fellow engineers in a fast-paced, distributed environment. The role combines hands-on software development with meaningful input into architecture, engineering practices, and technical decisions. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to automation and AI-enabled capabilities. This is a strong opportunity for an engineer who enjoys ownership, solving complex technical challenges, and helping shape products and engineering workflows as they scale.

Accountabilities


Design, develop, and maintain core platform features across frontend and backend systems. 
Contribute to technical decisions involving architecture, scalability, performance, security, reliability, and data integrity. 
Collaborate with product, design, QA, and engineering teams to deliver intuitive, reliable, and high-quality user experiences. 
Build clean, reusable, maintainable, secure, and testable code, including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. 
Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, standups, and other agile engineering activities. 
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues across the application stack. 
Help optimize application performance and contribute to automation, usability, developer experience, and engineering workflow improvements. 
Support the development of scalable systems and platform capabilities for a global user base. 


Requirements


3–5 years of professional experience in full stack software development, preferably within SaaS or enterprise environments. 
Strong experience with modern JavaScript technologies, particularly React and TypeScript, along with backend development using Node.js or Python. 
Solid understanding of RESTful services, API design, relational databases, and modern software development practices. 
Demonstrated ability to develop scalable, maintainable, secure, and well-tested software. 
Experience working in fast-paced startup environments and agile, collaborative engineering teams. 
Comfortable working remotely in a distributed, async-first environment and able to manage responsibilities independently. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a collaborative approach to working across engineering, product, design, and QA. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
Experience with technologies such as Next.js, Express, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD workflows is valuable.

job.title: Senior Engineer, API Network
job.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. job.description:
We’re Hiring: Node.js Backend Developer

Company: Cyurae

Experience: 3–5 years

Location: Gurugram — Onsite

Employment: Full-time

Working with: Founding team

About the Role

Cyurae is building an AI-powered consumer product at the intersection of fashion and technology. We are hiring a Node.js Backend Developer with hands-on experience in application architecture, scalable backend development, AI service integration and AWS deployment.

You will work directly with the founding team and own backend features from design through testing, deployment and production support. AWS deployment, CI/CD pipeline management and Docker management are core requirements. Sprint planning experience is an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Backend development and architecture: Build Node.js and TypeScript services with clear module boundaries and maintainable code. Design application architecture, data flows, API contracts and deployment structure, and document the trade-offs behind technical decisions.
API development and integration: Develop documented REST APIs for mobile and web applications. Implement authentication, authorization, validation, pagination and secure uploads. Integrate third-party services and coordinate API contracts with mobile and frontend developers.
Database design: Design relational schemas, queries, indexes, transactions and migrations using PostgreSQL or an equivalent database. Apply connection management and caching, and investigate query performance and data consistency issues.
AI services and background processing: Integrate AI and machine-learning services into backend workflows. Use AWS SQS, BullMQ or RabbitMQ for background tasks, with appropriate retries, timeouts, idempotency, failure handling and job status tracking.
Scalability and performance: Design services to handle growing workloads. Profile API latency, event-loop delays and database bottlenecks, and improve performance through caching, queues, concurrency controls and load testing.
AWS deployment and Docker management: Deploy and operate Node.js applications on AWS. Build and manage Docker images and containers, configure application environments and AWS services, and troubleshoot deployment, networking, permissions and runtime issues.
CI/CD and configuration management: Build and maintain pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions or Jenkins. Automate tests, Docker image builds and deployments. Manage configuration and secrets across environments, with reliable release and rollback procedures.
Monitoring and reliability: Configure logs, metrics, alerts and health checks. Investigate production incidents, apply access controls and rate limits, protect sensitive data and support backup and recovery procedures.
Testing and delivery: Write unit, integration and API tests, review code and maintain documentation. Work with the founding team, mobile developers, AI engineers and QA to deliver agreed features and resolve defects.

Required Skills and Experience

3–5 years of professional backend development experience, including production Node.js and TypeScript applications.
Practical experience designing application architecture, API boundaries, data flows and deployment approaches, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs.
Strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills, including async/await, promises, the Node.js event loop and error handling.
Experience building services with Express.js, NestJS, Fastify or an equivalent Node.js framework.
Strong SQL and database design skills, including indexing, transactions, migrations and query optimization. Familiarity with Redis or equivalent caching tools.
Hands-on AWS deployment and production operations experience is mandatory. Relevant services include EC2 or ECS, S3, RDS, IAM and CloudWatch.
Practical Docker and Linux experience, including image builds, container configuration, networking, logs and troubleshooting.
Hands-on CI/CD pipeline management using GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions or Jenkins, with familiarity with GitLab repositories and merge requests.
Experience integrating AI or machine-learning services and using AWS SQS, BullMQ or RabbitMQ for asynchronous processing.
Experience with automated testing, API security, monitoring and performance troubleshooting in deployed applications.
Willingness to work full-time onsite in Gurugram. Candidates based elsewhere must be willing to relocate.

Good to Have

Sprint planning, effort estimation, backlog refinement and task breakdown, with experience using Jira or similar tools.
Full-stack development experience with Next.js and React.
Infrastructure as code using Terraform or CloudFormation, automated provisioning and AWS cost optimization.
WebSockets or server-sent events for live updates, and experience collaborating with Python-based AI teams.

What We Want to See

Be ready to explain an application you personally designed, built and deployed: its architecture, database design, AI integrations, background jobs, AWS setup, Docker configuration and CI/CD pipeline.

Describe a production issue you resolved and how you verified the outcome. Highlight any contribution to sprint planning or delivery coordination.

How to Apply

Send your CV to contact@cyurae.com with the subject “Node.js Backend Developer Application.”

Include your current location, total experience, Node.js experience, notice period, current and expected CTC, and one or two relevant projects. Explain your contribution to application architecture, AWS deployment and CI/CD management.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer - AI who thrives at the intersection of modern web platforms and intelligent AI systems. You will own end-to-end product development — from architecting scalable backends to shipping polished React frontends — while actively leveraging Generative AI tools in your daily workflow.




This is a high-impact role at an AI-first company that also delivers world-class IT services. You will work on real-world AI-powered products, mentor engineers, shape architecture, and drive DevSecOps culture across the team.




Key Responsibilities:




Design, build, and maintain high-performance web platforms using Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI) and React.
Architect and implement scalable, resilient backend services and microservices with clean API design. Lead data modelling decisions across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis) databases.
Build and manage asynchronous task pipelines using Celery, RabbitMQ, and Redis for event-driven architectures.
Integrate and develop AI-powered features leveraging LLMs, RAG pipelines, Vector Databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB), and Agentic AI frameworks.
Use Gen AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as force multipliers in day-to-day development. Champion DevOps and DevSecOps best practices — CI/CD pipelines, containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes), IaC, SAST/DAST.
Conduct thorough code reviews, define engineering standards, and mentor junior/mid-level engineers.
Collaborate with Product, Design, and Data teams to translate requirements into robust, production-grade solutions.
Contribute to system design decisions, technical roadmaps, and architecture documentation.




Required Skills & Experience

Backend & Web Frameworks

5–8 years of professional software development experience.
Strong proficiency in Python; deep expertise in at least two of Django, Flask, or Fast API or Node JS.
Solid understanding of RESTful API design, GraphQL, and WebSocket-based communication.
Experience with auth patterns: OAuth2, JWT, RBAC, OpenID Connect.




Frontend

Proficiency in React.js with hooks, state management (Redux/Zustand/Context), and modern build tooling (Vite/Webpack).
Comfortable with TypeScript, responsive design, and component libraries (Material UI, Ant Design, Tailwind CSS).

Data & Databases

Strong data modelling skills for both transactional (SQL) and document/analytical workloads (NoSQL).
Hands-on with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, and DynamoDB.
Experience with database performance tuning, indexing strategies, and query optimisation.
Familiarity with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, or pgvector.

Messaging & Async Systems

Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Celery, and Redis for task queues and async processing.
Understanding of event-driven architectures, pub/sub patterns, and stream processing (Kafka is a plus).

DevOps & DevSecOps

Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerisation and orchestration.
Proficient in building CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins).
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and IaC tools (Terraform, Pulumi).
Knowledge of DevSecOps: SAST, DAST, secret management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), dependency scanning, OWASP Top 10.
Experience with observability stacks: logging, metrics, tracing (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).

Generative AI & LLM Ecosystem

Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini) and prompt engineering.
Working knowledge of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures and embedding pipelines.
Familiarity with Agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LangFuse, LangSmith, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
Comfortable using Gen AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as daily development tools.




Seniority-Level Expectations

Proven experience leading technical design discussions and producing Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
Strong grasp of software engineering principles: SOLID, DRY, CQRS, Event Sourcing, Domain-Driven Design.
Experience with performance profiling, load testing, and scaling strategies.
Ability to write clean, well-tested code with high coverage using pytest, Jest, Playwright or similar frameworks.
Excellent communication skills; experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.




Good to Have

Experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
Prior exposure to building or deploying AI agents or copilots in production.
Knowledge of MLOps practices and familiarity with model fine-tuning or embedding pipelines.
Contributions to open-source projects or a strong GitHub portfolio.
Experience in a startup or fast-paced product engineering environment.




Why Join Us?




AI-First Culture - Work with cutting-edge Gen AI tools and help shape AI-powered products from day one.




Real-World Impact - Build products used by real clients across industries — not just internal tools.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI
job.description:
The Opportunity

This is more than a full-stack role — it's your chance to build the AI layer of the platform the world's infrastructure runs on. Sitetracker is building Scout, our AI product line: production LLM systems and agentic workflows embedded in the software companies like Cox, Telefónica, and EVgo use to deploy critical infrastructure. As a Product Engineer, you'll take AI capabilities from idea to production agent orchestration and model integration on the backend, and the web and mobile experiences that put them in customers' hands.

This is shipping real, customer-facing AI , not prototypes or research demos. You'll own features end-to-end, work with frontier models (Anthropic, OpenAI), and see your work land in the hands of enterprise users deploying telecom networks, EV chargers, and renewable energy around the world.

What You’ll do:

As a Product Engineer on Scout, you'll hit the ground running and ship customer-facing AI from day one. You'll design, build, test, deploy, and monitor AI product features end-to-end , building agentic LLM systems with multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering over frontier models from Anthropic and OpenAI.

You'll work across the full stack: backend services in Python, Java, Node.js, or Go, and TypeScript/React frontends spanning both web and mobile app experiences. You'll make AI dependable by building automated evaluation pipelines, guardrails, and testing strategies for non-deterministic outputs — and running it on production infrastructure: scalable, fault-tolerant services on AWS and Kubernetes.

You'll think like a product engineer, not a ticket-taker: dig into user needs, absorb the problem space, make smart calls about what to build, keep stakeholders informed, and find ways to unblock yourself.

The Skills You’ll Have:

Full-Stack Product Engineering


Build production backend services in one or more of Python (FastAPI or similar), Java, Node.js, or Go
Ship production web interfaces in TypeScript and React; mobile app development (React Native or similar) is a plus
Design REST APIs and data models across relational and NoSQL databases
Own features end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring




AI / LLM Engineering


Build with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI): agentic workflows, tool/function calling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering. Production experience preferred; substantial personal or open-source projects considered
Write evaluation pipelines and testing strategies for non-deterministic AI outputs
Bonus: agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI), Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLMOps tooling (LangSmith, Langfuse), vector databases, or model serving (vLLM, GPU inference)




Production Systems & AI Infrastructure


Deploy and operate services on AWS with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD (Scout runs on AWS)
Instrument systems with observability and handle customer data securely in AI systems
Design fault-tolerant, scalable services that serve AI workloads reliably
Salesforce platform and Apex — Scout integrates with the Sitetracker Salesforce platform




Product Thinking & Communication


Dig into user needs and use that context to decide what to build and how
Explain technical decisions and AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
Break challenges into iterative solutions, keep stakeholders informed, and unblock myself




Within 90 Days, You’ll:


Ramp up on Scout's architecture, codebase, and AI tooling

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Client Platform
job.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.

P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.

The Opportunity

The Client Platform team is seeking a Senior Frontend Engineer to help us raise the quality bar across our frontend ecosystem. You'll establish engineering excellence through improved architecture, performance optimization, and maintainable code patterns that ensure our platform delivers exceptional experiences to both internal engineering teams and our 35+ million customers. This role is a unique opportunity to have immediate impact on the foundation that hundreds of Postman engineers rely on daily.

What You'll Do

The Client Platform team is a global engineering organization responsible for creating a "paved path" for all Postmanauts to develop and release web-based applications. Our platform is the foundation that hundreds of engineers at Postman rely on daily to deliver new features and improvements to over 30 million customers. We manage everything from build tooling and shared libraries to development infrastructure, best practices and our cross-platform desktop application.

Specifically You Will


Design and develop modular, well-documented SDKs and component libraries that serve both internal engineering teams as well as external developers, with focus on usability, accessibility, performance, and cross-platform compatibility.
Architect extensible frontend systems with clear boundaries, well-defined interfaces, and appropriate abstraction layers that balance customization needs with consistency requirements
Establish and evangelize architectural patterns that promote code quality, maintainability, and scalability across Postman's frontend ecosystem
Champion engineering excellence through active participation in architectural decisions, mentorship of other engineers in frontend best practices, and creation of standards that become embedded in our engineering culture and measurably improve code quality
Proactively partner with product and engineering to identify, prioritize, and eliminate technical debt through strategic refactoring and system enhancements, driving improved development velocity and platform reliability.


About You


8+ years in Frontend software engineering with demonstrated expertise in code quality, performance optimization, and engineering excellence.
Deep understanding of modern web technologies and best practices (JavaScript, TypeScript, React, state management, testing frameworks, etc.).
Experience designing and implementing maintainable, scalable frontend architectures for complex applications, including component libraries and SDKs that can be effectively reused across multiple systems.
Proven track record of raising the quality bar in previous roles through both technical solutions and positive cultural impact.
Additionally, you are someone who:
Communicates clearly and listens effectively. You seek new perspectives and build trust with your colleagues.
Loves the challenge of constraints and excels at finding creative solutions.
Takes ownership of problems, not solutions, and celebrates success as a team.

Nice-to-have


Experience with cross-platform applications (Electron or similar) and understanding the unique challenges of desktop/web hybrid environments.
Creating widely-adopted (open source) libraries/SDKs with 1000+ active developers.


What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

Equal Opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

Our client is a US-based healthcare technology startup founded by Harvard Business School alumni. recurring synchronization

retries and checkpoints
duplicate records and partial failures

retries with backoff
error handling

About Remoasset

Remoasset handles global laptop procurement and retrieval end-to-end. Companies buy, deliver, and recover devices across countries through our platform instead of chasing vendors, employees, and logistics providers themselves.

The product is a B2B SaaS platform covering the full device lifecycle — procurement, fulfilment, warehousing, deployment, and end-of-life recovery — with a customer-facing app, an internal admin portal, and integrations into MDM, ERP, and payment systems. It is real operational software: physical assets, multiple currencies, cross-border logistics, and workflows that cannot silently fail.




The role

You will own significant parts of the platform end-to-end — schema through API through UI. This is not a ticket-taking role. You will make architectural calls, push back on bad ones, and be accountable for what ships.

Expect to work across a TypeScript monorepo (Next.js frontends, Node-based API, PostgreSQL, Redis-backed workers) and on Python/FastAPI services where they are the better fit. We care that you can reason about systems, not that you have memorised one framework.




What you will do




Design and build features end-to-end: database schema, API contracts, background jobs, and the UI that consumes them
Model relational data properly — entities, constraints, indexes, migrations — for a domain with genuinely complex state transitions
Build and operate asynchronous workloads: background jobs, queue workers, and scheduled tasks for fulfilment, sync, and reconciliation flows
Design and evolve REST APIs consumed by multiple frontends and third-party integrations
Own deployment and operational health of what you build — CI/CD pipelines, observability, alerting, and incident response
Review code and raise the standard of the codebase through review, refactoring, and written technical direction
Mentor mid-level engineers and make onboarding faster for the people who come after you
Work directly with product and operations to turn ambiguous requirements into a concrete technical plan




What we are looking for (Required)




TypeScript — strong, idiomatic, comfortable with advanced types and strict mode
Next.js — App Router, server components, rendering strategies, and where the boundaries actually sit
Python — production experience, not scripting familiarity
FastAPI — building and running real services: dependency injection, Pydantic models, async handlers
PostgreSQL — schema design, query optimisation, indexing, transactions, and migration strategy
AWS — practical working knowledge across compute, storage, networking, secrets, and IAM
CI/CD — GitHub Actions or equivalent; you have built pipelines, not just consumed them
Redis — caching, queues, locks, and knowing when not to use it
Background jobs, workers, and schedulers — idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling, and what happens when a job runs twice




Also valuable

Containerised deployments (Docker, ECS/Fargate, or Kubernetes)
Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi, or CDK)
Payment integrations (Stripe or similar) and the failure modes that come with them
Observability tooling — structured logging, tracing, error tracking
Multi-tenant SaaS, RBAC, and auth systems (Cognito, Auth0, or equivalent)
Prior work in logistics, supply chain, ITAM, or another operationally heavy domain




What tells us you are senior

You have owned a system in production through at least one bad incident and changed the design afterwards
You can explain a technical trade-off to a non-engineer without dumbing it down
You write things down — decisions, runbooks, why the weird thing is weird
You disagree early and in writing rather than quietly building something you think is wrong




Hiring process

Introductory call — 30 minutes
Technical conversation — architecture and past work, no whiteboard algorithms
Practical exercise — a scoped, realistic problem, reviewed together
Final conversation with the founding team

Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.

We started in Manchester and now we’re global - with teams across the UK, US and India.




We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.










We are now looking for Senior Software Engineers to join #Team Green

Matillion is built around small development teams with responsibility for specific themes and initiatives. Each team is a mix of engineers with various levels of skills and experience. Java, Spring, Typescript, React, GraphQL, Docker, Kubernetes, MongoDB, DynamoDB, SpiceDB, SQL, Kafka, Restful services, Cloud Technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure), SSO, Agile (Scrum, Kanban)

job.title: Senior Principal Engineer
job.description:
TechGrove is the Centre of Excellence for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

 

Senior Principal Engineer

Technical Lead / Architect, TechGrove AI Engineering Pod

You are the kind of engineer other engineers want to build with. You have spent your career going deep on production systems, and you have reached the point where your judgment shapes architectures, raises teams, and makes hard problems look simple. This is the most senior technical seat in the pod, and it is unapologetically hands-on.

As Technical Lead and Architect, you own the architecture for an OpCo’s modernized applications and set the engineering bar the whole pod builds to. You operate as a player/coach: designing complex systems, writing meaningful code, and running rigorous reviews of work produced by both engineers and AI agents. You treat agentic development as a first-class part of the architecture, not a novelty, and you define how the pod gets the most out of it without ever compromising quality or security.

If you want your decisions to matter, your code to ship, and your standards to lift an entire team, this is built for you.

About the Pod

A TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self-contained, AI-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan’s AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match.

A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan’s India-based TechGrove.

What You Will Do
Own the architecture: Define and own the end-to-end software architecture for the pod’s applications, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, resilient, and cloud-native across AWS and Azure.
Own the frontend architecture: Set the frontend architecture: state management, a scalable library of reusable components, design-system integration, and the patterns, standards, and performance budgets the pod builds against.
Lead the technical direction: Serve as the highest technical authority and escalation point in the pod. Set design patterns and standards, and make confident architectural decisions amid ambiguity.
Stay hands-on: Operate as a player/coach. Make significant code contributions, lead complex designs, and deliver thorough code reviews of work from both engineers and AI agents.
Lead AI-native development: Define how the pod uses agentic tooling such as Claude Code across the SDLC, establishing patterns for AI-assisted design, implementation, testing, and review that maximize velocity while protecting quality and security.
Set the quality bar: Define and enforce engineering excellence: clean code, Domain-Driven Design, modern design patterns, Twelve-Factor principles, meaningful test coverage, and application security.
Build secure and reliable systems: Embed secure-by-design principles and cloud-native observability so applications run fast, stay available, and stay safe in production.
Mentor and raise the team: Coach senior engineers, grow the technical capability of the team (human and agentic), and foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
Partner with the OpCo: Work with the OpCo’s technical leadership and existing teams to align architecture with their landscape, integrate with existing systems, and transfer knowledge.
What You Bring
Experience: 10+ years in software engineering, with significant time in Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, or Architect roles leading the architecture of complex, production systems.
Production experience on BOTH AWS and Azure (required): You have personally designed, built, and run production software on both AWS and Azure. This dual-cloud depth is essential: you are the technical authority who sets cloud architecture regardless of which target cloud an OpCo runs on. Hands-on depth includes containers (Docker/Kubernetes), serverless (Lambda and Azure Functions), and Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform.
Architectural depth: Deep command of modern architectural patterns (microservices, event-driven, distributed systems), DDD, and design patterns, with a record of turning business objectives into technical solutions at enterprise or B2B scale.
Hands-on technical depth: Current, real coding ability. A player/coach who contributes code, leads design, and delivers thorough reviews, including of AI-generated work.
AI-native engineering: Demonstrated fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development tooling (Claude Code or similar) and a clear, practiced approach to architecting and delivering software in an AI-native team.
Modern tech stacks: Hands-on production experience with at least two of: .NET Core, Python, TypeScript, and Java.
Frontend architecture: Deep expertise in modern frontend architecture with React.js and Next.js: state management, scalable and reusable component design, design-system strategy, and frontend performance at scale.
DevSecOps: Strong command of CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and modern DevSecOps practices.
Communication and leadership: You align technical and business stakeholders, lead under competing priorities, and bring calm and clarity to fast-moving teams.
Nice to Have
Experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS at scale.
A track record leading application modernization or re-platforming of large enterprise or B2B applications.
GenAI architecture experience: RAG and GraphRAG, LLM orchestration, multi-agent frameworks, MCP servers and tools, context engineering, and vector databases.
Experience leading embedded or client-facing engineering teams.
Working knowledge of GCP, in addition to AWS and Azure.
What Success Looks Like
First 90 days: You understand the OpCo’s landscape, have set the architectural direction and engineering standards, and the pod is shipping against them with a clean, AI-native workflow.
First 6 months: The architecture is proven in production, quality and delivery metrics are trending up, and the team’s technical capability, human and agentic, has visibly grown under your leadership.
Why TechGrove, Why Banyan
Permanent home, long-term thinking: Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip.
Real ownership: You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the “what”; the pod owns the “how.”
AI-native by default: You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build.
Variety with stability: Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you.
Growth and excellence: A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time.
Should You Apply?

We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that.

We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes.

 

Beware of Recruitment Scams

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment. 

Protect yourself by following these steps:

Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware.com email address.
Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

job.title: Founding Engineer
job.description:
Founding Engineer CalybAI




About Calyb

At Calyb, we’re building General System Intelligence (GSI): a new class of AI systems that can understand enterprise knowledge, reason through complex workflows, and reliably execute work across business systems.

We’re building at the intersection of AI, software systems, enterprise knowledge and autonomous execution.

We’re looking for someone who wants to build the system, shape the product, and work with the team around it, We are not looking for someone to own a small, predefined slice of the system.




About the Role

This is a Founding Engineer role encompasses engineering/product and team leadership and execution.

Good engineering is the entry ticket.

The real requirement is ownership.

You will work closely with the founders to take problems from ambiguity to production, understanding the problem, deciding what should be built, building it, and eventually getting the team to execute it.

Over time, you should become someone who can be handed an entire engineering or product problem and trusted to take it forward without needing step-by-step direction.

This role is particularly suited to an early-career engineer who has already demonstrated unusually high ownership and wants to grow rapidly into a technical and organizational leader.




What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured by the number of tickets shipped.

You are successful when:

A vague problem can be handed to you and comes back as a clear product and engineering plan.
You can independently take important problems from idea → architecture → implementation → production.
Engineers around you become faster and better because of your involvement.
You identify problems before they become blockers and drive them to resolution.
You increasingly own engineering and product decisions without requiring constant founder involvement.
The team can execute larger and more complex projects because you are there.
Over time, the founders can hand you entire areas of engineering/product and trust you to run them.




Responsibilities




Build
Design and build core components of Calyb’s GSI platform across AI, agents, knowledge systems, orchestration and application infrastructure.
Take ambiguous technical problems from first principles and turn them into reliable production systems.
Make architectural decisions balancing performance, reliability, scalability and cost.
Work across the stack when required rather than being constrained by a particular technology or layer.
Debug difficult system-level problems and find simple solutions to complex technical challenges.
Think Product
Work with founders and customers to understand the actual problem behind a requirement.
Translate ambiguous business problems into clear product and engineering requirements.
Challenge requirements when the proposed solution does not address the underlying problem.
Decide what should be built, what should not be built, and what can be simplified.
Rapidly test ideas in the real world and iterate based on what is learned.
Own Execution
Take complete ownership of projects from problem definition through deployment and iteration.
Break large and ambiguous problems into executable work for the team.
Identify blockers, dependencies and risks before they impact delivery.
Establish the technical direction required to keep projects moving.
Take responsibility for outcomes rather than limiting ownership to assigned tasks.
Build with the Team
Work closely with engineers to solve difficult technical problems.
Review designs and code and raise the engineering quality bar.
Help engineers reason through problems rather than simply giving them solutions.
Improve engineering practices, development processes and technical standards.
Eventually take ownership of planning, prioritization and execution across engineering/product areas.
Help Calyb build a high-performance engineering culture as the team grows.




Qualifications




Must Have
Strong fundamentals in computer science and software engineering.
Excellent problem-solving ability and first-principles thinking.
Experience building and shipping real software, not just prototypes.
Ability to work effectively with ambiguous or incomplete requirements.
Strong ownership — you naturally take responsibility for getting things done.
Ability to understand a system end-to-end and reason about technical trade-offs.
Ability to communicate clearly with engineers, product stakeholders and customers.
Willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies quickly and use whatever tools are appropriate for the problem.
Around 2+ years of professional engineering experience is preferred, but demonstrated ability matters more than the number.

﻿

Particularly Valuable

Experience with one or more of:

AI/ML systems and LLM-based applications.
AI agents and agentic workflows.
Distributed systems and backend architecture.
Cloud infrastructure and scalable application architecture.
Databases and data-intensive systems.
Low-level systems, networking or performance engineering.
Python, C++, TypeScript, React, FastAPI or similar technologies.

You do not need experience with our exact stack.

We care much more about engineering fundamentals, learning velocity and problem-solving ability than a checklist of technologies.




The Kind of Person We’re Looking For




You don't need to have managed people before.

But you should be someone who naturally starts taking responsibility.

When a requirement is unclear, you don't wait for clarification for three days — you figure out what needs to be clarified.

When someone on the team is stuck, you don't assume it's someone else's problem.

When something isn't working, you don't stop at identifying the issue, you push until it is resolved.

When you disagree with an approach, you can explain why and propose something better.

And when you finish your own work, you're thinking about what the team needs next.

We are looking for someone who wants their scope to grow much faster than their job title.




Why Join Calyb?
Build GSI from the ground up: Work on a genuinely new class of AI systems rather than incremental features on an established product.
Real production problems: Your systems will be used by real customers, this is not a research or demo-only role.
Massive ownership: Your scope will expand as quickly as you demonstrate the ability to handle it.
Direct access to founders: Work closely with the people defining the product, technology and company.
Build the team: Help shape how Calyb engineers, builds and operates as the company grows.
Long-term growth: The goal is not to keep you in a “Founding Engineer” box. The role and responsibility should evolve with your impact.




Compensation & Location

We have a clear starting compensation structure for this role rather than negotiating individual CTC packages.

As your responsibility, impact and contribution grow, your role and compensation will grow with you.

Bangalore is preferred. We can work out a hybrid arrangement for the right person.

If you are looking for a narrowly defined engineering role, this probably isn't it.

If you want to build hard systems, understand the product, take ownership and grow into someone who can lead engineering and product — we should talk.
